about: Best-per-need lists. Each need is one read-only SQL query over the fshy store that returns rid plus the columns named in sort. The wiki renders them at /need/<id>/, the API at /api/v1/need/<id>, the MCP tool `need` and `fr need` run the same text. Duplicates (record.duplicate_of) are excluded by default. A row whose sort value is NULL is listed after the ranked rows, under 'no parsed number', never dropped.

needs.title: S3-compatible storage, no card
needs.scope: Usable storage offers with an S3 interface whose identity requirement was read and does not include a card. Sorted by USD per TB-month where a price parsed.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, usd_per_tb_month FROM record WHERE topic='storage' AND grp='usable' AND (interfaces LIKE '%s3%') AND needs_card=0 AND identity_basis='stated' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Bulk storage by price per TB-month
needs.scope: Storage offers with a parsed price per TB-month, usable or paid-only, cheapest first. Prices in other currencies are converted only with a dated rate cited in the corpus.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, usd_per_tb_month FROM record WHERE topic='storage' AND grp IN ('usable','paid') AND usd_per_tb_month IS NOT NULL AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Free storage with no card
needs.scope: Usable storage with a stated identity requirement that is not a card, best verdict and strongest evidence first.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE topic='storage' AND grp='usable' AND needs_card=0 AND identity_basis='stated' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Free or trial GPU time
needs.scope: Compute offers that mention GPU in their category or text and are usable or trial. Read the free tier line for hours per week or month.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE topic='compute' AND grp IN ('usable','trial') AND (category LIKE '%GPU%' OR rno IN (SELECT docid FROM text_fts WHERE text_fts MATCH 'offer:gpu')) AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Free compute with no card
needs.scope: Usable compute offers whose stated identity requirement is not a card.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE topic='compute' AND grp='usable' AND needs_card=0 AND identity_basis='stated' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Cheapest rented machines by USD a month
needs.scope: Compute offers with a parsed monthly USD price, cheapest first. A rented machine is a service; nothing here is hardware to buy.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, usd_month FROM record WHERE topic='compute' AND usd_month IS NOT NULL AND grp <> 'dead' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Inference APIs with no card and no phone
needs.scope: Usable model-inference endpoints, in the inference topic or categorised as inference elsewhere, whose stated identity needs neither a card nor a phone.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE (topic='inference' OR category LIKE '%inference%') AND grp='usable' AND needs_card=0 AND needs_phone=0 AND identity_basis='stated' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Usable with no account at all
needs.scope: Usable offers in any topic whose identity requirement is anonymous.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE grp='usable' AND identity_kind='anonymous' AND identity_basis='stated' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Offers that name a crypto payment rail
needs.scope: Records whose payment or identity text names a cryptocurrency. Not a verdict on the offer.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE crypto=1 AND grp <> 'dead' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Debrid and retrieval services by price
needs.scope: Debrid offers with a parsed price, cheapest first, then usable free offers.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, coalesce(usd_month, usd_per_tb_month) AS usd FROM record WHERE topic='debrid' AND grp IN ('usable','paid','trial') AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Free tunnels and egress paths
needs.scope: Usable ways to get traffic in or out: tunnels, relays, IPv6 brokers, VPN egress.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE topic='egress' AND grp='usable' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Free email sending and receiving
needs.scope: Usable transactional senders, mailboxes, forwarding and inbox APIs.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE topic='email' AND grp='usable' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Free databases and key-value stores
needs.scope: Usable hosted databases, vector stores and key-value stores.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE topic='databases-kv' AND grp='usable' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Free CI runners
needs.scope: Usable hosted CI runners and registries.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE topic='ci-cd-runners' AND grp='usable' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Free DNS, domains and certificates
needs.scope: Usable managed DNS, free domains and certificate authorities.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE topic='domains-dns' AND grp='usable' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Coding subscriptions by price
needs.scope: Coding-agent subscriptions with a parsed monthly price, cheapest first, then the rest.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, usd_month FROM record WHERE topic='coding-subs' AND grp <> 'dead' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Mountable pan drives and public instances
needs.scope: Usable netdisk and pan-drive offers, including public AList and OpenList instances.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE topic='netdisk-pan' AND grp='usable' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Free crawling, search and reader APIs
needs.scope: Usable crawl, search, reader and unblocker APIs.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE topic='crawler-scraper' AND grp='usable' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Free proxies and exit addresses
needs.scope: Usable proxy lists, VPN exits and address sources.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE topic='ip-proxy' AND grp='usable' AND duplicate_of IS NULL
